integrity: Two full independent acyclicity checks, exhaustive face test, program and deterministic output embedded; no independent audit or human verification claimed.
limitations: Finite four-dimensional hypercube only. Complete integral homology is proved, not complete unstable homotopy type or a family theorem. Nine-cell attaching map and automorphism representation remain undetermined. Publication priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent work.
title: Integral homology in two nonadjacent degrees for the four-cube dominance complex
